name: mcp-server-sevdesk
description: Safety-first sevDesk accounting: invoices, receipts, banking and reports. Read-only by default; binding steps need your confirmation. Unofficial.
long_description:
Connects Claude to your sevDesk account: contacts, invoices, credit notes, orders, receipts (Belege), bank transactions, parts and reports such as a VAT summary (Umsatzsteuer-Voranmeldung) and an EÜR-style profit and loss. It parses received e-invoices (XRechnung, ZUGFeRD), checks outgoing invoices for e-invoice readiness and suggests bank reconciliation matches.

**Safety first.** A sevDesk API token has full access to the account, so the extension is read-only by default. Tools that change data appear only after you enable their tier: write (drafts, contacts, parts), commit (finalize, book, cancel) and external (send e-mails). Commit and external actions ask you to confirm each one; dry run previews writes without sending them.

You need a sevDesk API token (sevDesk: Settings, Users, API token), ideally for a dedicated user. This is an unofficial community project, not affiliated with sevdesk GmbH.

api_token.title: sevDesk API token
api_token.description: Your sevDesk API token (sevDesk: Settings, Users, API token). It has full access to the account, so ideally create it for a dedicated user.

allow.title: Permission tiers
allow.description: Comma-separated tiers to enable: read, write, commit, external, or all. read is always on. write creates and changes drafts, contacts and parts; commit (finalize, book, cancel) and external (send e-mails) ask you to confirm each action.

read_only.title: Read only
read_only.description: Offer only read tools, whatever the permission tiers say.

dry_run.title: Dry run
dry_run.description: Write tools only return a preview of what they would send; nothing changes in sevDesk.

confirm.title: Confirmation
confirm.description: How you confirm commit and external actions: browser (an approval page opens in your browser) or elicit (a dialog in the chat, for clients that show one; Claude Desktop does not).

toolsets.title: Toolsets
toolsets.description: Comma-separated toolsets to load, e.g. invoices,vouchers,banking. Empty loads all except advanced; all also loads advanced (a generic read of the sevDesk API).

file_dir.title: Receipt folder
file_dir.description: A folder receipts and e-invoices may be read from, to attach them to vouchers (Belege) or import them. Empty: no local file is read.

output_dir.title: Output folder
output_dir.description: A folder where PDFs, e-invoice XML, CSV and DATEV exports may be saved. Empty: the file-saving tools are not offered.
